agent_explanation: The state-feedback controller prioritizes pole balance over cart centering: pole angle stays near -0.05 to -0.08 rad (margin ~0.72) with small corrective force (~0.3-0.9 N, far below the 41.4 N limit), while the cart drifts monotonically left from x=-0.31 (v=-0.48) through x=-1.62 at step 200 to x=-2.35 at step 260 and off the track at step 264. With no pushes or noise, the unchecked positional drift accumulates until cart_in_track is violated.
